message: Passing a non-numeric score in payload causes an unhandled ValueError and returns a 500 instead of a 4xx. Input conversion must be validated explicitly. Pre-existing: this line already exists on the base branch and the PR only moves it, so it doesn't block. Fix it here if it's cheap, otherwise open a ticket.
test_valid_score_accepted does not assert the HTTP status code (200), and tests do not cover non-integer score inputs.
